# Awesome-MCP - MCP Server Catalog

[Browse the website](https://awesome-mcp.com/en) | [Contribute](CONTRIBUTING.md)

8 catalog records, grouped by category. This is a metadata snapshot, not an installation or security endorsement.

No install commands, private submissions, credentials, synthetic metrics or unreviewed capability definitions are exported.

Repository availability and upstream behavior may change. Review upstream documentation before installing anything.

## Developer Tools

- [Gemini Mcp 38d14e](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/gemini-mcp-38d14e) - Google Gemini MCP - Use Google's visual, video and chat capabilities in your AI Assistant\. 14 tools, with setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/houtini-ai/gemini-mcp).
- [Legivel](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/legivel) - Markdown or saved templates in, typeset PDF out: tables, math, diagrams\. 100 free documents a month\. Setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/mcp-community/legivel).
- [Postbye](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/postbye) - Postbye MCP server: cancellation letters, mailing addresses and how-to-cancel guides for 8,600\+ companies\. Setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/postbye-team/postbye-mcp).
- [Singapore Proxy 89a96b](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/singapore-proxy-89a96b) - A hosted MCP server that lets your AI agent browse the web as if it were on a Singapore mobile network\. Setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/Xavierfok/singapore-proxy-mcp).
- [Xhostd](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/xhostd) - Agent-first hosting\. From Claude, Cursor, or Codex, your agent can create an app, push code, and deploy it to a live HTTPS URL, with managed… Setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/xhostd/xhostd-sdk).

## AI, Agents & Models

- [Knowledge Graph Memory](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/memory) - Store and retrieve entities, relations and observations in a persistent local knowledge graph\. [Source](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/memory).
- [Sequential Thinking](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/sequential-thinking) - Organize problem solving into revisable, branching thought steps through an MCP tool\. [Source](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/sequentialthinking).

## Media & Design

- [Tesseract](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/tesseract) - Connects an AI app to Tesseract's hosted MCP server \(https://app\.tesseract\.dev/api/core/tesseract/mcp, Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in with a Tesseract account\) to make pictures, picture edits, effects and short videos, charged to the person's own Tesseract plan\. The repository is the public plugin and connection manifest \(with two skills for Claude Code\); the hosted server is closed source, run by Eightcell Labs, Inc\. A second hosted server, Tesseract Decks &amp; Designs \(https://app\.tesseract\.dev/api/core/tesseract/mcp/design\), lays out slide decks, diagrams, charts and designs without any AI model\. Docs: https://tesseract\.dev/mcp/ [Source](https://github.com/opentech-dev/tesseract-claude-plugin).

## Contributing

Add one structured JSON file under `data/servers/` and open a pull request. CI validates bounded metadata and canonical identities; maintainers review proposals before merging.

A merged catalog proposal is not proof of a working installation, official ownership, interface review or measured popularity. Website synchronization requires the reviewed import job; merging alone does not overwrite production data.
